title: Iehoshabeth
summary: Raleigh names Iehoshabeth in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Iehoshabeth, wife of the high Priest, daughter of King Iehoram and sister to Ahazia, by whose care Ioash was conueighed out of the nourserie. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXI, §. IV, sig. 320b–321a
